# CLI reference

```text
usage: setup | balance | pda | domain | mcp | show config | show intent | quote | cancel | expire | close | advance-nonce | advance-epoch | create swap|limit|dutch|attested | list | mandate grant|show|revoke|use <kind> | approve | revoke-approval | signed prepare <kind>|submit | init-config | update-config | set-economics | propose-admin | accept-admin | solve | raise-pause | lower-pause | crank | treasury | solver-table | events | jobs | deliver | version | help [command]
```

Every command accepts `--output` and `--help`.

`INTENT_ENGINE_KEYPAIR` fills in `--keypair` and `INTENT_ENGINE_URL` fills in `--url` when they are not given. `--url` takes an RPC URL or one of `localnet`, `devnet`, `testnet`, `mainnet-beta`.

## setup

```text
setup [--url <cluster>] [--keypair <file>]
```

Options: `--url`, `--keypair`, `--output`, `--help`

## balance

```text
balance [--keypair <file> | --owner <address>] [--mints <mint,...>]
```

Options: `--url`, `--keypair`, `--owner`, `--mints`, `--output`, `--help`

## version

```text
version
```

Prints the CLI version. `--version` does the same.

## help

```text
help [command]
```

Prints the usage of every command, or of one command. `--help` after a command does the same.
